newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacDun tops turnover list before AGM.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacDun tops turnover list before AGM.

text.p: The shares of diversified manufacturer Pacific Dunlop Ltd topped the turnover list at midday ahead of the company's annual meeting in Melbourne.
At 12.15 p.m. (0115 GMT), Pacific Dunlop shares were seven cents higher at A$2.85 on turnover of 8.1 million shares.

Brokers said a line of more than 2.8 million shares had been specialed by Bain Securities at a price of A$2.80 each while there had been four parcels of one million shares put through the market by various other brokers.
"The turnover is pretty high for Pacific Dunlop, obviously investors are looking for a better outlook from the company at today's annual meeting," a Melbourne-based dealer said.
